segments.tr: تتغير الأرقام والاتجاهات بمرور الوقت؛ استشر البيانات الحالية من المصادر الرسمية ومحترف مؤهل قبل اتخاذ قرارات مالية.*

fr.title: Tendus derrière le volant : Pourquoi les impayés de prêts automobiles attirent l'attention de Wall Street

segments.src: For many American households, the car is not a luxury.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux ménages américains, la voiture n'est pas un luxe.

segments.src: It is how people get to work, take children to school and reach the doctor.
segments.tr: C'est ainsi que les gens se rendent au travail, emmènent les enfants à l'école et vont chez le médecin.

segments.src: That is why trouble in auto lending tends to get noticed quickly.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les difficultés dans le secteur des prêts automobiles ont tendance à être rapidement remarquées.

segments.src: When borrowers fall behind on car payments, it often signals that other parts of the household budget are under pressure too.
segments.tr: Lorsque les emprunteurs prennent du retard dans leurs paiements de voiture, cela signale souvent que d'autres postes du budget familial sont également sous pression.

segments.src: In recent years, rising delinquency rates, especially among borrowers with weaker credit, have drawn the attention of analysts, investors and regulators.
segments.tr: Ces dernières années, la hausse des taux de retard de paiement, en particulier chez les emprunteurs ayant un crédit plus fragile, a attiré l'attention des analystes, des investisseurs et des régulateurs.

segments.src: This article looks at why auto loan stress has grown, what the numbers suggest, and whether lenders and the broader economy have reason to worry.
segments.tr: Cet article examine les raisons pour lesquelles la tension sur les prêts automobiles s'est accrue, ce que suggèrent les chiffres et si les prêteurs ainsi que l'économie en général ont des raisons de s'inquiéter.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales et non d'un conseil financier.

segments.src: ## Why the pressure has built up
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la pression s'est accumulée

segments.src: Several trends have combined to make car ownership more expensive.
segments.tr: Plusieurs tendances se sont combinées pour rendre la possession d'une voiture plus coûteuse.

segments.src: **Higher vehicle prices.** New and used vehicle prices rose sharply after supply chain disruptions limited inventory in the early 2020s.
segments.tr: **Des prix de véhicules plus élevés.** Les prix des véhicules neufs et d'occasion ont fortement augmenté après que les perturbations de la chaîne d'approvisionnement ont limité les stocks au début des années 2020.

segments.src: Although price growth has cooled, the average transaction price remains well above where it stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Bien que la hausse des prix se soit calmée, le prix moyen des transactions reste bien supérieur à ce qu'il était avant la pandémie.

segments.src: Many buyers who purchased at the peak are still paying off those loans.
segments.tr: De nombreux acheteurs qui ont acheté au plus haut remboursent encore ces prêts.

segments.src: **Higher interest rates.** As the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate to fight inflation, auto loan rates climbed with it.
segments.tr: **Des taux d'intérêt plus élevés.** Alors que la Réserve fédérale a relevé son taux directeur pour lutter contre l'inflation, les taux des prêts automobiles ont grimpe avec lui.

segments.src: A borrower with strong credit may now pay noticeably more than a few years ago.
segments.tr: Un emprunteur disposant d'un excellent crédit peut désormais payer nettement plus cher qu'il y a quelques années.

segments.src: A borrower with a lower credit score may face rates in the double digits, which adds a large amount to the monthly payment.
segments.tr: Un emprunteur ayant une cote de crédit inférieure peut faire face à des taux à deux chiffres, ce qui ajoute une somme importante à la mensualité.

segments.src: **Longer loan terms.** To keep monthly payments manageable, many buyers have chosen terms of 72 or even 84 months.
segments.tr: **Des durées de prêt plus longues.** Pour maintenir des mensualités abordables, de nombreux acheteurs ont choisi des durées de 72 ou même 84 mois.

segments.src: A longer term lowers the monthly bill but increases total interest paid.
segments.tr: Une durée plus longue réduit la facture mensuelle mais augmente le total des intérêts payés.

segments.src: It also lengthens the time a borrower may owe more than the car is worth, a situation often called negative equity.
segments.tr: Cela prolonge également la période pendant laquelle un emprunteur peut devoir plus que la valeur de la voiture, une situation souvent appelée fonds propres négatifs (ou « negative equity »).

segments.src: **Rising insurance, repair and living costs.** The loan payment is only one part of ownership.
segments.tr: **Hausse des coûts d'assurance, de réparation et de la vie.** Le remboursement du prêt ne constitue qu'une partie des coûts de propriété.

segments.src: Insurance premiums, maintenance and fuel have also gone up, and so have groceries and rent.
segments.tr: Les primes d'assurance, l'entretien et le carburant ont également augmenté, tout comme les courses et les loyers.

segments.src: For households with little savings, a small shock can lead to a missed payment.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages disposant de peu d'épargne, un petit choc peut entraîner un impayé.

segments.src: ## What the delinquency data show
segments.tr: ## Ce que montrent les données sur les retards de paiement

segments.src: Data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and from credit reporting and rating agencies have shown serious auto loan delinquencies rising in recent years, in some measures reaching their highest levels in over a decade.
segments.tr: Les données de la Banque de la Réserve fédérale de New York ainsi que des agences d'évaluation du crédit et de notation ont montré une hausse des retards de paiement graves sur les prêts auto ces dernières années, atteignant pour certaines mesures leurs niveaux les plus élevés depuis plus d'une décennie.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform:
segments.tr: La situation n'est pas uniforme :

segments.src: - **Subprime borrowers** show the sharpest increases. Rating agencies that track subprime auto asset-backed securities have reported delinquency rates that, for some lenders, are at or near record highs.
segments.tr: - **Les emprunteurs subprime** enregistrent les hausses les plus marquées. Les agences de notation qui suivent les titres adossés à des actifs automobiles subprime ont fait état de taux d'impayés qui, pour certains prêteurs, atteignent ou avoisinent des niveaux record.

segments.src: - **Prime and super-prime borrowers** have remained far more stable, with delinquency rates that are low by historical standards.
segments.tr: - **Les emprunteurs prime et super-prime** sont restés beaucoup plus stables, avec des taux d'impayés historiquement bas.

segments.src: - **Repossessions** have risen as well, though the pace and the exact figures vary by source and by month.
segments.tr: - **Les saisies de véhicules** ont également augmenté, bien que le rythme et les chiffres exacts varient selon la source et le mois.

segments.src: These differences matter.
segments.tr: Ces différences sont importantes.

segments.src: The overall picture is not one of widespread collapse, but of a growing group of borrowers at the lower end of the credit spectrum who are having trouble keeping up.
segments.tr: Le tableau d'ensemble n'est pas celui d'un effondrement généralisé, mais plutôt celui d'un groupe croissant d'emprunteurs au bas de l'échelle du crédit qui éprouvent des difficultés à suivre.

segments.src: ## Why Wall Street is paying attention
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi Wall Street y prête attention

segments.src: Most auto loans are not held by the lender that makes them.
segments.tr: La plupart des prêts automobiles ne sont pas conservés par le prêteur qui les accorde.

segments.src: Many are bundled into asset-backed securities and sold to investors, so stress among borrowers can show up in financial markets.
segments.tr: Beaucoup sont regroupés dans des titres adossés à des actifs (ABS) et vendus à des investisseurs, de sorte que le stress des emprunteurs peut se répercuter sur les marchés financiers.

segments.src: Investors watch several indicators:
segments.tr: Les investisseurs surveillent plusieurs indicateurs :

segments.src: 1. **Delinquency and default rates** on pools of loans, which affect the cash flow paid to bondholders.
segments.tr: 1. **Les taux d'impayés et de défaut** sur les portefeuilles de prêts, qui affectent les flux de trésorerie versés aux détenteurs d'obligations.

segments.src: 2. **Recovery values**, meaning how much a lender gets when a repossessed vehicle is sold. Used car prices strongly influence this.
segments.tr: 2. **Les valeurs de recouvrement**, c'est-à-dire le montant qu'un prêteur obtient lors de la revente d'un véhicule saisi. Le prix des voitures d'occasion influence fortement cette valeur.

segments.src: 3. **Lender health.** Some subprime lenders and "buy here, pay here" dealers depend on borrowers with thin credit files, so they are more exposed when payments slip.
segments.tr: 3. **La santé des prêteurs.** Certains prêteurs subprime et concessionnaires « achetez ici, payez ici » dépendent d'emprunteurs ayant des dossiers de crédit minces ; ils sont donc plus exposés lorsque les paiements glissent.

segments.src: 4. **Spillover to other credit.** Analysts often treat auto loan trouble as an early signal for credit cards, personal loans and other consumer debt.
segments.tr: 4. **Les effets de contagion sur d'autres crédits.** Les analystes considèrent souvent les difficultés des prêts auto comme un signal d'alarme précoce pour les cartes de crédit, les prêts personnels et d'autres dettes à la consommation.

segments.src: A few high-profile lender troubles have reinforced concern, though they have not by themselves indicated a system-wide problem.
segments.tr: Quelques défaillances de prêteurs très médiatisées ont renforcé les inquiétudes, bien qu'elles n'indiquent pas en elles-mêmes un problème systémique.

segments.src: ## Is this a repeat of 2008?
segments.tr: ## Est-ce une répétition de 2008 ?

segments.src: Comparisons to the housing crisis are common, but there are important differences.
segments.tr: Les comparaisons avec la crise immobilière sont fréquentes, mais il existe des différences majeures.

segments.src: The auto loan market is much smaller than the mortgage market was, with total balances measured in roughly the low trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: Le marché du prêt automobile est beaucoup plus restreint que ne l'était le marché hypothécaire, avec des encours totaux qui se comptent en bas de quelques milliers de milliards de dollars.

segments.src: Subprime borrowers represent a minority of outstanding balances.
segments.tr: Les emprunteurs subprime représentent une minorité des encours.

segments.src: Auto loans are also typically smaller and shorter than mortgages, and lenders can repossess a vehicle relatively quickly.
segments.tr: De plus, les prêts auto sont généralement plus modestes et plus courts que les prêts hypothécaires, et les prêteurs peuvent saisir un véhicule relativement rapidement.

segments.src: Banks' capital positions are also stronger than they were before 2008.
segments.tr: Les fonds propres des banques sont également plus solides qu'avant 2008.

segments.src: Even so, the same warning signs deserve watching: loosening underwriting, long terms, and loans packaged and sold on to investors.
segments.tr: Même ainsi, les mêmes signaux d'alerte méritent d'être surveillés : assouplissement des conditions d'octroi, durées allongées et prêts titrisés puis vendus aux investisseurs.

segments.src: Most analysts describe the current situation as a pocket of stress rather than a systemic threat, but they acknowledge that conditions could change if unemployment rises or used car values fall sharply.
segments.tr: La plupart des analystes décrivent la situation actuelle comme une zone de tension ciblée plutôt que comme une menace systémique, mais ils reconnaissent que la situation pourrait changer si le chômage augmente ou si la valeur des véhicules d'occasion chute brutalement.

segments.src: ## What it says about household stress
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela révèle sur la pression subie par les ménages

segments.src: Auto delinquencies are informative because people usually prioritize their car payment, since losing the vehicle can mean losing a job.
segments.tr: Les impayés automobiles sont révélateurs car les gens donnent généralement la priorité au paiement de leur voiture, la perte du véhicule pouvant entraîner la perte d'un emploi.

segments.src: When even that payment goes unpaid, it suggests households are running out of options.
segments.tr: Lorsque même ce paiement n'est plus honoré, cela suggère que les ménages sont à court d'options.

segments.src: Other signs often cited alongside it include higher credit card balances, more use of "buy now, pay later" services and a slowdown in the growth of savings.
segments.tr: D'autres signes souvent cités en parallèle incluent des solde de cartes de crédit plus élevés, un recours accru aux services de type « achetez maintenant, payez plus tard » et un ralentissement de la croissance de l'épargne.

segments.src: At the same time, many households remain in solid shape.
segments.tr: Dans le même temps, de nombreux ménages restent dans une situation solide.

segments.src: Employment has been relatively strong and wages have grown in many sectors.
segments.tr: L'emploi a été relativement soutenu et les salaires ont progressé dans de nombreux secteurs.

segments.src: The stress is concentrated, not universal, which is why the strength of the labor market remains the key variable to watch.
segments.tr: Le stress est concentré et non universel, c'est pourquoi la solidité du marché du travail reste la variable clé à surveiller.

segments.src: ## What borrowers can do
segments.tr: ## Que peuvent faire les emprunteurs ?

segments.src: For people struggling with a car payment, acting early helps:
segments.tr: Pour les personnes aux prises avec le paiement d'une voiture, agir tôt aide :

segments.src: - **Contact the lender before missing a payment.** Many offer deferments, extensions or modified terms.
segments.tr: - **Contactez le prêteur avant d'avoir un impayé.** Beaucoup proposent des reports, des prolongations ou des conditions modifiées.

segments.src: - **Consider refinancing** if your credit has improved or rates have fallen, but watch for fees and for terms that extend the loan too far.
segments.tr: - **Envisagez de refinancer** si votre crédit s'est amélioré ou si les taux ont baissé, mais faites attention aux frais et aux conditions qui allongent trop le prêt.

segments.src: - **Compare the full cost,** not only the monthly payment, when shopping for a vehicle. Total interest and loan length matter.
segments.tr: - **Comparez le coût total,** et pas seulement la mensualité, lors de l'achat d'un véhicule. Le total des intérêts et la durée du prêt sont essentiels.

segments.src: - **Avoid rolling negative equity** from an old loan into a new one, which can deepen the debt.
segments.tr: - **Évitez de reporter un capital restant dû négatif** d'un ancien prêt sur un nouveau, ce qui peut aggraver la dette.

segments.src: - **Seek help from a nonprofit credit counseling agency** if several debts are becoming difficult to manage.
segments.tr: - **Demandez l'aide d'un organisme à but non lucratif de conseil en crédit** si plusieurs dettes deviennent difficiles à gérer.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Que faut-il surveiller ensuite ?

segments.src: Several developments will shape the outlook:
segments.tr: Plusieurs évolutions façonneront les perspectives :

segments.src: - The direction of interest rates and whether auto loan costs ease.
segments.tr: - L'orientation des taux d'intérêt et l'éventuel assouplissement du coût des prêts auto.

segments.src: - Used vehicle prices, which affect both borrower equity and lender recoveries.
segments.tr: - Le prix des véhicules d'occasion, qui influence à la fois la valeur nette de l'emprunteur et le recouvrement des prêteurs.

segments.src: - The labor market, particularly layoffs among lower-income workers.
segments.tr: - Le marché du travail, en particulier les licenciements chez les travailleurs à faibles revenus.

segments.src: - Underwriting standards at lenders and the performance of newer loan pools.
segments.tr: - Les critères d'octroi de crédit chez les prêteurs et la performance des portefeuilles de prêts plus récents.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusion

segments.src: Rising auto loan delinquencies do not by themselves mean a financial crisis is coming.
segments.tr: La hausse des retards de paiement sur les prêts automobiles ne signifie pas en soi qu'une crise financière se profile.

segments.src: But they are a useful gauge of how pressure from high prices and high borrowing costs is reaching ordinary households, especially those with weaker credit.
segments.tr: C'est cependant un indicateur utile de la façon dont la pression liée aux prix élevés et aux coûts d'emprunt élevés touche les ménages ordinaires, en particulier ceux dont le crédit est plus fragile.

segments.src: For lenders and investors, the message is to monitor closely and underwrite carefully.
segments.tr: Pour les prêteurs et les investisseurs, le message est de surveiller attentivement et d'accorder les crédits avec prudence.

segments.src: For borrowers, it is a reminder that the cheapest monthly payment is not always the best deal.
segments.tr: Pour les emprunteurs, cela rappelle que la mensualité la plus basse n'est pas toujours la meilleure affaire.

pt.title: Apertados ao Volante: Por Que a Inadimplência de Empréstimos de Carros Está Chamando a Atenção de Wall Street

segments.src: For many American households, the car is not a luxury.
segments.tr: Para muitas famílias americanas, o carro não é um luxo.

segments.src: It is how people get to work, take children to school and reach the doctor.
segments.tr: É a forma como as pessoas vão para o trabalho, levam os filhos para a escola e chegam ao médico.

segments.src: That is why trouble in auto lending tends to get noticed quickly.
segments.tr: É por isso que problemas no crédito automotivo costumam ser notados rapidamente.

segments.src: When borrowers fall behind on car payments, it often signals that other parts of the household budget are under pressure too.
segments.tr: Quando os mutuários atrasam os pagamentos do carro, isso geralmente sinaliza que outras partes do orçamento familiar também estão sob pressão.

segments.src: In recent years, rising delinquency rates, especially among borrowers with weaker credit, have drawn the attention of analysts, investors and regulators.
segments.tr: Nos últimos anos, o aumento das taxas de inadimplência, especialmente entre mutuários com crédito mais fraco, atraiu a atenção de analistas, investidores e reguladores.

segments.src: This article looks at why auto loan stress has grown, what the numbers suggest, and whether lenders and the broader economy have reason to worry.
segments.tr: Este artigo analisa por que o estresse nos empréstimos de carros cresceu, o que os números sugerem e se os credores e a economia em geral têm motivos para se preocupar.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Trata-se de informação geral, não de consultoria financeira.

segments.src: ## Why the pressure has built up
segments.tr: ## Por que a pressão aumentou

segments.src: Several trends have combined to make car ownership more expensive.
segments.tr: Várias tendências se combinaram para tornar a posse de um carro mais cara.

segments.src: **Higher vehicle prices.** New and used vehicle prices rose sharply after supply chain disruptions limited inventory in the early 2020s.
segments.tr: **Preços de veículos mais altos.** Os preços de veículos novos e usados subiram drasticamente após as interrupções na cadeia de suprimentos limitarem o estoque no início dos anos 2020.

segments.src: Although price growth has cooled, the average transaction price remains well above where it stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Embora o crescimento dos preços tenha esfriado, o preço médio de transação permanece bem acima do patamar anterior à pandemia.

segments.src: Many buyers who purchased at the peak are still paying off those loans.
segments.tr: Muitos compradores que adquiriram no pico ainda estão pagando esses empréstimos.

segments.src: **Higher interest rates.** As the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate to fight inflation, auto loan rates climbed with it.
segments.tr: **Taxas de juros mais altas.** À medida que o Federal Reserve aumentou sua taxa de referência para combater a inflação, as taxas de empréstimo de carros subiram junto.

segments.src: A borrower with strong credit may now pay noticeably more than a few years ago.
segments.tr: Um mutuário com crédito forte agora pode pagar visivelmente mais do que há alguns anos.

segments.src: A borrower with a lower credit score may face rates in the double digits, which adds a large amount to the monthly payment.
segments.tr: Um mutuário com pontuação de crédito mais baixa pode enfrentar taxas na faixa de dois dígitos, o que adiciona um valor substancial ao pagamento mensal.

segments.src: **Longer loan terms.** To keep monthly payments manageable, many buyers have chosen terms of 72 or even 84 months.
segments.tr: **Prazos de empréstimo mais longos.** Para manter os pagamentos mensais administráveis, muitos compradores escolheram prazos de 72 ou até 84 meses.

segments.src: A longer term lowers the monthly bill but increases total interest paid.
segments.tr: Um prazo mais longo reduz a fatura mensal, mas aumenta o total de juros pagos.

segments.src: It also lengthens the time a borrower may owe more than the car is worth, a situation often called negative equity.
segments.tr: Também prolonga o período em que um mutuário pode dever mais do que o carro vale, situação frequentemente chamada de patrimônio líquido negativo.

segments.src: **Rising insurance, repair and living costs.** The loan payment is only one part of ownership.
segments.tr: **Aumento dos custos de seguro, reparo e vida.** O pagamento do empréstimo é apenas uma parte da posse.

segments.src: Insurance premiums, maintenance and fuel have also gone up, and so have groceries and rent.
segments.tr: Os prêmios de seguro, manutenção e combustível também subiram, assim como mantimentos e aluguel.

segments.src: For households with little savings, a small shock can lead to a missed payment.
segments.tr: Para famílias com poucas economias, um pequeno choque pode levar a um pagamento perdido.

segments.src: ## What the delinquency data show
segments.tr: ## O que os dados de inadimplência mostram

segments.src: Data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and from credit reporting and rating agencies have shown serious auto loan delinquencies rising in recent years, in some measures reaching their highest levels in over a decade.
segments.tr: Dados do Federal Reserve Bank de Nova York e de agências de classificação e relatórios de crédito mostraram que a inadimplência grave em empréstimos de carros tem aumentado nos últimos anos, atingindo em algumas medidas seus níveis mais altos em mais de uma década.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform:
segments.tr: O padrão não é uniforme:

segments.src: - **Subprime borrowers** show the sharpest increases. Rating agencies that track subprime auto asset-backed securities have reported delinquency rates that, for some lenders, are at or near record highs.
segments.tr: - **Mutuários subprime** apresentam os aumentos mais acentuados. Agências de classificação que acompanham títulos garantidos por ativos automotivos subprime relataram taxas de inadimplência que, para alguns credores, estão em recordes ou próximos deles.

segments.src: - **Prime and super-prime borrowers** have remained far more stable, with delinquency rates that are low by historical standards.
segments.tr: - **Mutuários prime e super-prime** permaneceram muito mais estáveis, com taxas de inadimplência baixas para os padrões históricos.

segments.src: - **Repossessions** have risen as well, though the pace and the exact figures vary by source and by month.
segments.tr: - **Repulsas** (apreensões) de veículos também aumentaram, embora o ritmo e os números exatos variavam conforme a fonte e o mês.

segments.src: These differences matter.
segments.tr: Essas diferenças importam.

segments.src: The overall picture is not one of widespread collapse, but of a growing group of borrowers at the lower end of the credit spectrum who are having trouble keeping up.
segments.tr: O panorama geral não é de colapso generalizado, mas sim de um grupo crescente de mutuários na faixa inferior do espectro de crédito que está tendo problemas para acompanhar os pagamentos.

segments.src: ## Why Wall Street is paying attention
segments.tr: ## Por que Wall Street está prestando atenção

segments.src: Most auto loans are not held by the lender that makes them.
segments.tr: A maioria dos empréstimos de carros não é mantida pelo credor que os emitiu.

segments.src: Many are bundled into asset-backed securities and sold to investors, so stress among borrowers can show up in financial markets.
segments.tr: Muitos são empacotados em títulos garantidos por ativos e vendidos a investidores, de modo que o estresse entre os mutuários pode aparecer nos mercados financeiros.

segments.src: Investors watch several indicators:
segments.tr: Os investidores acompanham vários indicadores:

segments.src: 1. **Delinquency and default rates** on pools of loans, which affect the cash flow paid to bondholders.
segments.tr: 1. **Taxas de inadimplência e inadimplência total** em pools de empréstimos, que afetam o fluxo de caixa pago aos detentores de títulos.

segments.src: 2. **Recovery values**, meaning how much a lender gets when a repossessed vehicle is sold. Used car prices strongly influence this.
segments.tr: 2. **Valores de recuperação**, ou seja, quanto um credor obtém quando um veículo apreendido é vendido. Os preços de carros usados influenciam fortemente isso.

segments.src: 3. **Lender health.** Some subprime lenders and "buy here, pay here" dealers depend on borrowers with thin credit files, so they are more exposed when payments slip.
segments.tr: 3. **Saúde do credor.** Alguns credores subprime e revendedores de "compre aqui, pague aqui" dependem de mutuários com histórico de crédito escasso, portanto ficam mais expostos quando os pagamentos atrasam.

segments.src: 4. **Spillover to other credit.** Analysts often treat auto loan trouble as an early signal for credit cards, personal loans and other consumer debt.
segments.tr: 4. **Efeito transbordamento para outros créditos.** Analistas frequentemente tratam problemas em empréstimos de carros como um sinal precoce para cartões de crédito, empréstimos pessoais e outras dívidas de consumidores.

segments.src: A few high-profile lender troubles have reinforced concern, though they have not by themselves indicated a system-wide problem.
segments.tr: Alguns problemas em credores de destaque reforçaram a preocupação, embora por si só não tenham indicado um problema sistêmico.

segments.src: ## Is this a repeat of 2008?
segments.tr: ## Isso é uma repetição de 2008?

segments.src: Comparisons to the housing crisis are common, but there are important differences.
segments.tr: Comparações com a crise imobiliária são comuns, mas há diferenças importantes.

segments.src: The auto loan market is much smaller than the mortgage market was, with total balances measured in roughly the low trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: O mercado de empréstimos automotivos é muito menor do que o mercado de hipotecas era, com saldos totais medidos em cerca de poucos trilhões de dólares.

segments.src: Subprime borrowers represent a minority of outstanding balances.
segments.tr: Mutuários subprime representam uma minoria dos saldos pendentes.

segments.src: Auto loans are also typically smaller and shorter than mortgages, and lenders can repossess a vehicle relatively quickly.
segments.tr: Os empréstimos de carros também são tipicamente menores e mais curtos do que as hipotecas, e os credores podem reaver um veículo relativamente rápido.

segments.src: Banks' capital positions are also stronger than they were before 2008.
segments.tr: As posições de capital dos bancos também são mais fortes do que eram antes de 2008.

segments.src: Even so, the same warning signs deserve watching: loosening underwriting, long terms, and loans packaged and sold on to investors.
segments.tr: Mesmo assim, os mesmos sinais de alerta merecem monitoramento: flexibilização de subscrição, prazos longos e empréstimos empacotados e vendidos a investidores.

segments.src: Most analysts describe the current situation as a pocket of stress rather than a systemic threat, but they acknowledge that conditions could change if unemployment rises or used car values fall sharply.
segments.tr: A maioria dos analistas descreve a situação atual como um bolsão de estresse em vez de uma ameaça sistêmica, mas reconhecem que as condições podem mudar se o desemprego subir ou os valores de carros usados caírem drasticamente.

segments.src: ## What it says about household stress
segments.tr: ## O que isso diz sobre o estresse familiar

segments.src: Auto delinquencies are informative because people usually prioritize their car payment, since losing the vehicle can mean losing a job.
segments.tr: A inadimplência automotiva é informativa porque as pessoas geralmente priorizam o pagamento do carro, já que perder o veículo pode significar perder o emprego.

segments.src: When even that payment goes unpaid, it suggests households are running out of options.
segments.tr: Quando até esse pagamento deixa de ser feito, sugere que as famílias estão ficando sem opções.

segments.src: Other signs often cited alongside it include higher credit card balances, more use of "buy now, pay later" services and a slowdown in the growth of savings.
segments.tr: Outros sinais frequentemente citados junto a isso incluem saldos mais altos de cartões de crédito, maior uso de serviços "compre agora, pague depois" e uma desaceleração no crescimento das economias.

segments.src: At the same time, many households remain in solid shape.
segments.tr: Ao mesmo tempo, muitas famílias permanecem em situação sólida.

segments.src: Employment has been relatively strong and wages have grown in many sectors.
segments.tr: O emprego tem sido relativamente forte e os salários cresceram em muitos setores.

segments.src: The stress is concentrated, not universal, which is why the strength of the labor market remains the key variable to watch.
segments.tr: O estresse é concentrado, não universal, razão pela qual a força do mercado de trabalho continua sendo a principal variável a ser observada.

segments.src: ## What borrowers can do
segments.tr: ## O que os mutuários podem fazer

segments.src: For people struggling with a car payment, acting early helps:
segments.tr: Para pessoas que lutam com o pagamento de um carro, agir cedo ajuda:

segments.src: - **Contact the lender before missing a payment.** Many offer deferments, extensions or modified terms.
segments.tr: - **Contatar o credor antes de perder um pagamento.** Muitos oferecem adiamentos, extensões ou termos modificados.

segments.src: - **Consider refinancing** if your credit has improved or rates have fallen, but watch for fees and for terms that extend the loan too far.
segments.tr: - **Considerar refinanciar** se seu crédito melhorou ou as taxas caíram, mas fique atento a taxas e termos que estendam o empréstimo demais.

segments.src: - **Compare the full cost,** not only the monthly payment, when shopping for a vehicle. Total interest and loan length matter.
segments.tr: - **Comparar o custo total,** e não apenas o pagamento mensal, ao comprar um veículo. O total de juros e a duração do empréstimo importam.

segments.src: - **Avoid rolling negative equity** from an old loan into a new one, which can deepen the debt.
segments.tr: - **Evitar transferir patrimônio líquido negativo** de um empréstimo antigo para um novo, o que pode aprofundar a dívida.

segments.src: - **Seek help from a nonprofit credit counseling agency** if several debts are becoming difficult to manage.
segments.tr: - **Buscar ajuda de uma agência de aconselhamento de crédito sem fins lucrativos** se várias dívidas estiverem se tornando difíceis de gerenciar.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: Several developments will shape the outlook:
segments.tr: Vários desenvolvimentos moldarão as perspectivas:

segments.src: - The direction of interest rates and whether auto loan costs ease.
segments.tr: - A direção das taxas de juros e se os custos de empréstimos automotivos diminuem.

segments.src: - Used vehicle prices, which affect both borrower equity and lender recoveries.
segments.tr: - Os preços de veículos usados, que afetam tanto o patrimônio do mutuário quanto as recuperações do credor.

segments.src: - The labor market, particularly layoffs among lower-income workers.
segments.tr: - O mercado de trabalho, particularmente demissões entre trabalhadores de menor renda.

segments.src: - Underwriting standards at lenders and the performance of newer loan pools.
segments.tr: - Padrões de subscrição nos credores e o desempenho de novos pools de empréstimos.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: Rising auto loan delinquencies do not by themselves mean a financial crisis is coming.
segments.tr: O aumento da inadimplência em empréstimos de carros não significa por si só que uma crise financeira está chegando.

segments.src: But they are a useful gauge of how pressure from high prices and high borrowing costs is reaching ordinary households, especially those with weaker credit.
segments.tr: Mas são um indicador útil de como a pressão de preços altos e custos de empréstimos elevados está atingindo as famílias comuns, especialmente aquelas com crédito mais fraco.

segments.src: For lenders and investors, the message is to monitor closely and underwrite carefully.
segments.tr: Para credores e investidores, a mensagem é monitorar de perto e avaliar com cuidado.

segments.src: For borrowers, it is a reminder that the cheapest monthly payment is not always the best deal.
segments.tr: Para os mutuários, é um lembrete de que o pagamento mensal mais barato nem sempre é o melhor negócio.

in.title: Tertekan di Balik Kemudi: Mengapa Tunggakan Pinjaman Mobil Menarik Perhatian Wall Street

segments.src: For many American households, the car is not a luxury.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak rumah tangga di Amerika, mobil bukanlah barang mewah.

segments.src: It is how people get to work, take children to school and reach the doctor.
segments.tr: Mobil adalah cara orang pergi bekerja, mengantar anak ke sekolah, dan mendatangi dokter.

segments.src: That is why trouble in auto lending tends to get noticed quickly.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya masalah dalam pinjaman otomotif cenderung cepat mendapat perhatian.

segments.src: When borrowers fall behind on car payments, it often signals that other parts of the household budget are under pressure too.
segments.tr: Ketika peminjam terlambat membayar cicilan mobil, hal itu sering kali menjadi sinyal bahwa bagian lain dari anggaran rumah tangga juga sedang mengalami tekanan.

segments.src: In recent years, rising delinquency rates, especially among borrowers with weaker credit, have drawn the attention of analysts, investors and regulators.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, peningkatan tingkat tunggakan, terutama di antara peminjam dengan kredit yang lebih lemah, telah menarik perhatian analis, investor, dan regulator.

segments.src: This article looks at why auto loan stress has grown, what the numbers suggest, and whether lenders and the broader economy have reason to worry.
segments.tr: Artikel ini membahas mengapa tekanan pinjaman mobil meningkat, apa yang ditunjukkan oleh angka-angka tersebut, dan apakah pemberi pinjaman serta ekonomi secara lebih luas memiliki alasan untuk khawatir.

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan.

segments.src: ## Why the pressure has built up
segments.tr: ## Mengapa tekanan ini terakumulasi

segments.src: Several trends have combined to make car ownership more expensive.
segments.tr: Beberapa tren telah bergabung membuat kepemilikan mobil menjadi lebih mahal.

segments.src: **Higher vehicle prices.** New and used vehicle prices rose sharply after supply chain disruptions limited inventory in the early 2020s.
segments.tr: **Harga kendaraan yang lebih tinggi.** Harga kendaraan baru dan bekas melonjak tajam setelah gangguan rantai pasokan membatasi inventaris pada awal tahun 2020-an.

segments.src: Although price growth has cooled, the average transaction price remains well above where it stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Meskipun pertumbuhan harga telah mereda, rata-rata harga transaksi tetap jauh di atas posisinya sebelum pandemi.

segments.src: Many buyers who purchased at the peak are still paying off those loans.
segments.tr: Banyak pembeli yang membeli pada saat puncak harga masih menyelesaikan pembayaran pinjaman tersebut.

segments.src: **Higher interest rates.** As the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate to fight inflation, auto loan rates climbed with it.
segments.tr: **Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi.** Saat Federal Reserve menaikkan suku bunga acuan untuk melawan inflasi, suku bunga pinjaman mobil ikut meningkat.

segments.src: A borrower with strong credit may now pay noticeably more than a few years ago.
segments.tr: Peminjam dengan kredit kuat mungkin sekarang membayar spadan lebih mahal dibandingkan beberapa tahun lalu.

segments.src: A borrower with a lower credit score may face rates in the double digits, which adds a large amount to the monthly payment.
segments.tr: Peminjam dengan skor kredit lebih rendah mungkin menghadapi suku bunga dua digit, yang menambahkan jumlah besar pada pembayaran bulanan.

segments.src: **Longer loan terms.** To keep monthly payments manageable, many buyers have chosen terms of 72 or even 84 months.
segments.tr: **Jangka waktu pinjaman yang lebih panjang.** Agar cicilan bulanan tetap terjangkau, banyak pembeli memilih jangka waktu 72 atau bahkan 84 bulan.

segments.src: A longer term lowers the monthly bill but increases total interest paid.
segments.tr: Jangka waktu yang lebih panjang menurunkan tagihan bulanan tetapi meningkatkan total bunga yang dibayarkan.

segments.src: It also lengthens the time a borrower may owe more than the car is worth, a situation often called negative equity.
segments.tr: Ini juga memperpanjang waktu di mana peminjam mungkin utang lebih besar daripada nilai mobil itu sendiri, situasi yang sering disebut ekuitas negatif.

segments.src: **Rising insurance, repair and living costs.** The loan payment is only one part of ownership.
segments.tr: **Peningkatan biaya asuransi, perbaikan, dan biaya hidup.** Pembayaran pinjaman hanyalah satu bagian dari kepemilikan.

segments.src: Insurance premiums, maintenance and fuel have also gone up, and so have groceries and rent.
segments.tr: Premi asuransi, pemeliharaan, dan bahan bakar juga naik, begitu pula bahan pokok dan sewa rumah.

segments.src: For households with little savings, a small shock can lead to a missed payment.
segments.tr: Bagi rumah tangga dengan sedikit tabungan, guncangan kecil dapat menyebabkan pembayaran terlewat.

segments.src: ## What the delinquency data show
segments.tr: ## Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh data tunggakan

segments.src: Data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and from credit reporting and rating agencies have shown serious auto loan delinquencies rising in recent years, in some measures reaching their highest levels in over a decade.
segments.tr: Data dari Federal Reserve Bank of New York serta dari lembaga pelaporan dan pemeringkat kredit menunjukkan tunggakan pinjaman mobil yang serius meningkat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, dalam beberapa ukuran mencapai level tertinggi dalam lebih dari satu dekade.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform:
segments.tr: Polanya tidak seragam:

segments.src: - **Subprime borrowers** show the sharpest increases. Rating agencies that track subprime auto asset-backed securities have reported delinquency rates that, for some lenders, are at or near record highs.
segments.tr: - **Peminjam subprime** menunjukkan peningkatan paling tajam. Lembaga pemeringkat yang memantau efek beragun aset (ABS) otomotif subprime telah melaporkan tingkat tunggakan yang, untuk beberapa pemberi pinjaman, berada pada atau mendekati rekor tertinggi.

segments.src: - **Prime and super-prime borrowers** have remained far more stable, with delinquency rates that are low by historical standards.
segments.tr: - **Peminjam prime dan super-prime** tetap jauh lebih stabil, dengan tingkat tunggakan yang rendah menurut standar historis.

segments.src: - **Repossessions** have risen as well, though the pace and the exact figures vary by source and by month.
segments.tr: - **Penyitaan kembali (reposses)** juga telah meningkat, meskipun laju dan angka pastinya bervariasi berdasarkan sumber dan bulan.

segments.src: These differences matter.
segments.tr: Perbedaan-perbedaan ini penting.

segments.src: The overall picture is not one of widespread collapse, but of a growing group of borrowers at the lower end of the credit spectrum who are having trouble keeping up.
segments.tr: Gambaran keseluruhannya bukanlah keruntuhan yang meluas, melainkan sekelompok peminjam yang terus bertumbuh di spektrum kredit bawah yang mengalami kesulitan untuk bertahan.

segments.src: ## Why Wall Street is paying attention
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Wall Street memperhatikan

segments.src: Most auto loans are not held by the lender that makes them.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar pinjaman mobil tidak dipegang oleh pemberi pinjaman yang mengeluarkannya.

segments.src: Many are bundled into asset-backed securities and sold to investors, so stress among borrowers can show up in financial markets.
segments.tr: Banyak yang dikemas ke dalam efek beragun aset dan dijual kepada investor, sehingga tekanan di antara peminjam dapat muncul di pasar keuangan.

segments.src: Investors watch several indicators:
segments.tr: Investor memantau beberapa indikator:

segments.src: 1. **Delinquency and default rates** on pools of loans, which affect the cash flow paid to bondholders.
segments.tr: 1. **Tingkat tunggakan dan gagal bayar** pada kumpulan pinjaman, yang mempengaruhi arus kas yang dibayarkan kepada pemegang obligasi.

segments.src: 2. **Recovery values**, meaning how much a lender gets when a repossessed vehicle is sold. Used car prices strongly influence this.
segments.tr: 2. **Nilai pemulihan (recovery values)**, yang berarti berapa banyak yang didapat pemberi pinjaman ketika kendaraan yang disita dijual. Harga mobil bekas sangat mempengaruhi hal ini.

segments.src: 3. **Lender health.** Some subprime lenders and "buy here, pay here" dealers depend on borrowers with thin credit files, so they are more exposed when payments slip.
segments.tr: 3. **Kesehatan pemberi pinjaman.** Beberapa pemberi pinjaman subprime dan dealer "buy here, pay here" bergantung pada peminjam dengan riwayat kredit yang minim, sehingga mereka lebih terpapar ketika pembayaran meleset.

segments.src: 4. **Spillover to other credit.** Analysts often treat auto loan trouble as an early signal for credit cards, personal loans and other consumer debt.
segments.tr: 4. **Dampak limpahan ke kredit lain.** Analis sering menganggap masalah pinjaman mobil sebagai sinyal awal untuk kartu kredit, pinjaman pribadi, dan utang konsumen lainnya.

segments.src: A few high-profile lender troubles have reinforced concern, though they have not by themselves indicated a system-wide problem.
segments.tr: Beberapa masalah pemberi pinjaman yang terkenal telah memperkuat kekhawatiran, meskipun masalah tersebut secara independen tidak mengindikasikan masalah di seluruh sistem.

segments.src: ## Is this a repeat of 2008?
segments.tr: ## Apakah ini pengulangan tahun 2008?

segments.src: Comparisons to the housing crisis are common, but there are important differences.
segments.tr: Perbandingan dengan krisis perumahan memang umum, tetapi terdapat perbedaan penting.

segments.src: The auto loan market is much smaller than the mortgage market was, with total balances measured in roughly the low trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: Pasar pinjaman mobil jauh lebih kecil daripada pasar hipotek saat itu, dengan total saldo diukur sekitar triliunan dolar yang rendah.

segments.src: Subprime borrowers represent a minority of outstanding balances.
segments.tr: Peminjam subprime mewakili minoritas dari saldo yang belum dilunasi.

segments.src: Auto loans are also typically smaller and shorter than mortgages, and lenders can repossess a vehicle relatively quickly.
segments.tr: Pinjaman mobil juga biasanya lebih kecil dan lebih pendek daripada hipotek, dan pemberi pinjaman dapat menyita kembali kendaraan dengan relatif cepat.

segments.src: Banks' capital positions are also stronger than they were before 2008.
segments.tr: Posisi modal bank juga lebih kuat dibandingkan sebelum 2008.

segments.src: Even so, the same warning signs deserve watching: loosening underwriting, long terms, and loans packaged and sold on to investors.
segments.tr: Meskipun demikian, tanda-tanda peringatan yang sama layak untuk dipantau: melonggarnya penjaminan (underwriting), jangka waktu yang panjang, dan pinjaman yang dikemas lalu dijual ke investor.

segments.src: Most analysts describe the current situation as a pocket of stress rather than a systemic threat, but they acknowledge that conditions could change if unemployment rises or used car values fall sharply.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar analis menggambarkan situasi saat ini sebagai kantong tekanan (pocket of stress) daripada ancaman sistemik, tetapi mereka mengakui bahwa kondisi dapat berubah jika pengangguran meningkat atau nilai mobil bekas turun tajam.

segments.src: ## What it says about household stress
segments.tr: ## Apa yang diungkapkannya tentang tekanan rumah tangga

segments.src: Auto delinquencies are informative because people usually prioritize their car payment, since losing the vehicle can mean losing a job.
segments.tr: Tunggakan mobil sangat informatif karena orang biasanya memprioritaskan pembayaran mobil mereka, karena kehilangan kendaraan dapat berarti kehilangan pekerjaan.

segments.src: When even that payment goes unpaid, it suggests households are running out of options.
segments.tr: Ketika pembayaran itu pun tidak terbayar, ini menunjukkan bahwa rumah tangga mulai kehabisan pilihan.

segments.src: Other signs often cited alongside it include higher credit card balances, more use of "buy now, pay later" services and a slowdown in the growth of savings.
segments.tr: Tanda-tanda lain yang sering dikutip bersamaan dengannya termasuk saldo kartu kredit yang lebih tinggi, peningkatan penggunaan layanan "beli sekarang, bayar nanti" (buy now, pay later), dan perlambatan pertumbuhan tabungan.

segments.src: At the same time, many households remain in solid shape.
segments.tr: Pada saat yang sama, banyak rumah tangga tetap berada dalam kondisi yang baik.

segments.src: Employment has been relatively strong and wages have grown in many sectors.
segments.tr: Lapangan kerja relatif kuat dan upah telah tumbuh di banyak sektor.

segments.src: The stress is concentrated, not universal, which is why the strength of the labor market remains the key variable to watch.
segments.tr: Tekanan ini terkonsentrasi, tidak universal, itulah sebabnya kekuatan pasar tenaga kerja tetap menjadi variabel kunci yang harus dipantau.

segments.src: ## What borrowers can do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang bisa dilakukan peminjam

segments.src: For people struggling with a car payment, acting early helps:
segments.tr: Bagi orang yang kesulitan dengan cicilan mobil, bertindak lebih awal sangat membantu:

segments.src: - **Contact the lender before missing a payment.** Many offer deferments, extensions or modified terms.
segments.tr: - **Hubungi pemberi pinjaman sebelum terlambat membayar.** Banyak yang menawarkan penundaan, perpanjangan, atau persyaratan yang dimodifikasi.

segments.src: - **Consider refinancing** if your credit has improved or rates have fallen, but watch for fees and for terms that extend the loan too far.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan refinansiasi** jika kredit Anda telah membaik atau suku bunga telah turun, tetapi waspadai biaya dan jangka waktu yang memperpanjang pinjaman terlalu jauh.

segments.src: - **Compare the full cost,** not only the monthly payment, when shopping for a vehicle. Total interest and loan length matter.
segments.tr: - **Bandingkan total biaya,** bukan hanya cicilan bulanan, saat berbelanja kendaraan. Total bunga dan jangka waktu pinjaman sangat penting.

segments.src: - **Avoid rolling negative equity** from an old loan into a new one, which can deepen the debt.
segments.tr: - **Hindari memindahkan ekuitas negatif** dari pinjaman lama ke pinjaman baru, yang dapat memperdalam utang.

segments.src: - **Seek help from a nonprofit credit counseling agency** if several debts are becoming difficult to manage.
segments.tr: - **Cari bantuan dari lembaga konseling kredit nirlaba** jika beberapa utang mulai sulit dikelola.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus dipantau selanjutnya

segments.src: Several developments will shape the outlook:
segments.tr: Beberapa perkembangan akan membentuk prospek ke depan:

segments.src: - The direction of interest rates and whether auto loan costs ease.
segments.tr: - Arah suku bunga dan apakah biaya pinjaman mobil melunak.

segments.src: - Used vehicle prices, which affect both borrower equity and lender recoveries.
segments.tr: - Harga kendaraan bekas, yang mempengaruhi ekuitas peminjam dan pemulihan pemberi pinjaman.

segments.src: - The labor market, particularly layoffs among lower-income workers.
segments.tr: - Pasar tenaga kerja, khususnya pemutusan hubungan kerja di antara pekerja berpenghasilan lebih rendah.

segments.src: - Underwriting standards at lenders and the performance of newer loan pools.
segments.tr: - Standar penjaminan (underwriting) di pemberi pinjaman dan kinerja kumpulan pinjaman yang lebih baru.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Rising auto loan delinquencies do not by themselves mean a financial crisis is coming.
segments.tr: Meningkatnya tunggakan pinjaman mobil tidak dengan sendirinya berarti krisis keuangan akan datang.

segments.src: But they are a useful gauge of how pressure from high prices and high borrowing costs is reaching ordinary households, especially those with weaker credit.
segments.tr: Namun, ini adalah tolok ukur yang berguna tentang bagaimana tekanan dari harga tinggi dan biaya pinjaman yang tinggi menjangkau rumah tangga biasa, terutama mereka yang memiliki kredit lebih lemah.

segments.src: For lenders and investors, the message is to monitor closely and underwrite carefully.
segments.tr: Bagi pemberi pinjaman dan investor, pesannya adalah memantau dengan cermat dan melakukan penjaminan dengan hati-hati.

segments.src: For borrowers, it is a reminder that the cheapest monthly payment is not always the best deal.
segments.tr: Bagi peminjam, ini adalah pengingat bahwa cicilan bulanan termurah tidak selalu merupakan penawaran terbaik.

ja.title: ハンドルを握る家計の逼迫：自動車ローンの延滞がウォール街の注目を集めている理由

segments.src: For many American households, the car is not a luxury.
segments.tr: 多くの米国家計にとって、車は贅沢品ではない。

segments.src: It is how people get to work, take children to school and reach the doctor.
segments.tr: 仕事に通い、子供を学校に送り、医者に行くための手段である。

segments.src: That is why trouble in auto lending tends to get noticed quickly.
segments.tr: そのため、自動車ローン市場の不調はすぐに注目を集める傾向がある。

segments.src: When borrowers fall behind on car payments, it often signals that other parts of the household budget are under pressure too.
segments.tr: 借り手が車の支払いを滞納し始めると、それは家計の他の部分も圧迫されている兆候であることが多い。

segments.src: In recent years, rising delinquency rates, especially among borrowers with weaker credit, have drawn the attention of analysts, investors and regulators.
segments.tr: 近年、特に信用力の低い借り手を中心に延滞率が上昇しており、アナリスト、投資家、規制当局の関心を集めている。

segments.src: This article looks at why auto loan stress has grown, what the numbers suggest, and whether lenders and the broader economy have reason to worry.
segments.tr: この記事では、自動車ローンのストレスが拡大した理由、数字が示唆するもの、そして貸し手や広範な経済が懸念すべき理由があるのかどうかを探る。

segments.src: It is general information, not financial advice.
segments.tr: これは一般的な情報であり、財務上のアドバイスではない。

segments.src: ## Why the pressure has built up
segments.tr: ## プレッシャーが高まった理由

segments.src: Several trends have combined to make car ownership more expensive.
segments.tr: いくつかのトレンドが重なり、車の保有コストが上昇している。

segments.src: **Higher vehicle prices.** New and used vehicle prices rose sharply after supply chain disruptions limited inventory in the early 2020s.
segments.tr: **車両価格の高騰。** 新車および中古車の価格は、2020年代初頭のサプライチェーンの混乱によって在庫が制限された後、急激に上昇した。

segments.src: Although price growth has cooled, the average transaction price remains well above where it stood before the pandemic.
segments.tr: 価格上昇は落ち着いたものの、平均取引価格はパンデミック前を大きく上回ったままである。

segments.src: Many buyers who purchased at the peak are still paying off those loans.
segments.tr: ピーク時に購入した多くの買い手が、現在もそのローンを返済中である。

segments.src: **Higher interest rates.** As the Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate to fight inflation, auto loan rates climbed with it.
segments.tr: **金利の上昇。** 連邦準備制度（FRB）がインフレ抑制のために政策金利を引き上げるにつれて、自動車ローンの金利も上昇した。

segments.src: A borrower with strong credit may now pay noticeably more than a few years ago.
segments.tr: 信用力の高い借り手であっても、数年前より明らかに多くの支払いを強いられる場合がある。

segments.src: A borrower with a lower credit score may face rates in the double digits, which adds a large amount to the monthly payment.
segments.tr: 信用スコアが低い借り手は二桁台の金利に直面する可能性があり、月々の返済額に大きな負担を加えることになる。

segments.src: **Longer loan terms.** To keep monthly payments manageable, many buyers have chosen terms of 72 or even 84 months.
segments.tr: **ローンの長期化。** 月々の返済額を手頃に抑えるため、多くの買い手が72回、あるいは84回払いを選択している。

segments.src: A longer term lowers the monthly bill but increases total interest paid.
segments.tr: 長期化により月々の支払額は減るが、支払う利息の総額は増加する。

segments.src: It also lengthens the time a borrower may owe more than the car is worth, a situation often called negative equity.
segments.tr: また、車の価値よりもローンの残高が多い状態（いわゆるネガティブ・エクイティ）が続く期間も長くなる。

segments.src: **Rising insurance, repair and living costs.** The loan payment is only one part of ownership.
segments.tr: **保険料、修理費、生活費の上昇。** ローンの支払いは所有コストの一部にすぎない。

segments.src: Insurance premiums, maintenance and fuel have also gone up, and so have groceries and rent.
segments.tr: 保険料、メンテナンス費用、燃料費も上昇しており、食料品や家賃も同様である。

segments.src: For households with little savings, a small shock can lead to a missed payment.
segments.tr: 貯蓄がほとんどない家計にとって、小さなショックが支払いの遅延につながる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## What the delinquency data show
segments.tr: ## 延滞データが示すもの

segments.src: Data from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York and from credit reporting and rating agencies have shown serious auto loan delinquencies rising in recent years, in some measures reaching their highest levels in over a decade.
segments.tr: ニューヨーク連銀や信用情報・格付機関のデータによると、近年、深刻な自動車ローンの延滞が増加しており、一部の指標では10年以上ぶりの高水準に達している。

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform:
segments.tr: この傾向は一様ではない：

segments.src: - **Subprime borrowers** show the sharpest increases. Rating agencies that track subprime auto asset-backed securities have reported delinquency rates that, for some lenders, are at or near record highs.
segments.tr: - **サブプライム層の借り手**が最も急激な増加を示している。サブプライム自動車資産担保証券（ABS）を追跡している格付機関は、一部の貸し手において延滞率が過去最高またはそれに近い水準にあると報告している。

segments.src: - **Prime and super-prime borrowers** have remained far more stable, with delinquency rates that are low by historical standards.
segments.tr: - **プライム層およびスーパープライム層の借り手**ははるかに安定しており、歴史的基準から見れば低い延滞率にとどまっている。

segments.src: - **Repossessions** have risen as well, though the pace and the exact figures vary by source and by month.
segments.tr: - **差し押さえ**も増加しているが、そのペースや正確な数値は情報源や月によって異なる。

segments.src: These differences matter.
segments.tr: これらの違いは重要である。

segments.src: The overall picture is not one of widespread collapse, but of a growing group of borrowers at the lower end of the credit spectrum who are having trouble keeping up.
segments.tr: 全体像は広範囲にわたる崩壊ではなく、信用スペクトルの下位に位置する、支払いに苦労している借り手のグループが拡大しているというものである。

segments.src: ## Why Wall Street is paying attention
segments.tr: ## ウォール街が注目している理由

segments.src: Most auto loans are not held by the lender that makes them.
segments.tr: ほとんどの自動車ローンは、それを実行した貸し手が保有し続けているわけではない。

segments.src: Many are bundled into asset-backed securities and sold to investors, so stress among borrowers can show up in financial markets.
segments.tr: 多くは資産担保証券（ABS）にまとめられて投資家に販売されるため、借り手のストレスが金融市場に表面化することがある。

segments.src: Investors watch several indicators:
segments.tr: 投資家はいくつかの指標を注視している：

segments.src: 1. **Delinquency and default rates** on pools of loans, which affect the cash flow paid to bondholders.
segments.tr: 1. **ローン・プールの延滞率およびデフォルト率**：債券保有者に支払われるキャッシュフローに影響を与える。

segments.src: 2. **Recovery values**, meaning how much a lender gets when a repossessed vehicle is sold. Used car prices strongly influence this.
segments.tr: 2. **回収価値**：差し押さえ車両が売却された際に貸し手がいくら回収できるかを示す。中古車価格がこれを強く左右する。

segments.src: 3. **Lender health.** Some subprime lenders and "buy here, pay here" dealers depend on borrowers with thin credit files, so they are more exposed when payments slip.
segments.tr: 3. **貸し手の健全性**：一部のサブプライム系貸し手や「buy here, pay here（その場で買ってその場で支払う）」型のディーラーは信用情報の薄い借り手に依存しているため、支払いが滞った際により大きな影響を受ける。

segments.src: 4. **Spillover to other credit.** Analysts often treat auto loan trouble as an early signal for credit cards, personal loans and other consumer debt.
segments.tr: 4. **他の信用への波及**：アナリストは、自動車ローンの問題をクレジットカード、個人ローン、その他の消費者向け債務の早期警報として捉えることが多い。

segments.src: A few high-profile lender troubles have reinforced concern, though they have not by themselves indicated a system-wide problem.
segments.tr: いくつかの著名な貸し手のトラブルが懸念を強めているが、それ単体でシステム全体の問題を示しているわけではない。

segments.src: ## Is this a repeat of 2008?
segments.tr: ## これは2008年の再来か？

segments.src: Comparisons to the housing crisis are common, but there are important differences.
segments.tr: 住宅危機との比較によく見られるが、重要な違いがある。

segments.src: The auto loan market is much smaller than the mortgage market was, with total balances measured in roughly the low trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: 自動車ローン市場は住宅ローン市場よりもはるかに小さく、総残高は2兆ドル強の規模である。

segments.src: Subprime borrowers represent a minority of outstanding balances.
segments.tr: サブプライム層の借り手が占める残高の割合は少数派である。

segments.src: Auto loans are also typically smaller and shorter than mortgages, and lenders can repossess a vehicle relatively quickly.
segments.tr: また、自動車ローンは通常、住宅ローンよりも金額が小さく期間も短いため、貸し手は比較的迅速に車両を差し押さえることができる。

segments.src: Banks' capital positions are also stronger than they were before 2008.
segments.tr: 銀行の資本ポジションも2008年当時より強固である。

segments.src: Even so, the same warning signs deserve watching: loosening underwriting, long terms, and loans packaged and sold on to investors.
segments.tr: それでも、審査の緩和、長期化、パッケージ化されて投資家に販売されるローンなど、同じ警告サインには監視が必要である。

segments.src: Most analysts describe the current situation as a pocket of stress rather than a systemic threat, but they acknowledge that conditions could change if unemployment rises or used car values fall sharply.
segments.tr: ほとんどのアナリストは、現在の状況をシステミックな脅威というよりもストレスのポケット（局所的な歪み）と表現しているが、失業率が上昇したり中古車価格が急落したりすれば状況が変わる可能性があることは認めている。

segments.src: ## What it says about household stress
segments.tr: ## 家計のストレスについて何がわかるか

segments.src: Auto delinquencies are informative because people usually prioritize their car payment, since losing the vehicle can mean losing a job.
segments.tr: 自動車ローンの延滞が参考になるのは、車を失うことが職を失うことにつながるため、人々は通常、自動車ローンの支払いを優先するからである。

segments.src: When even that payment goes unpaid, it suggests households are running out of options.
segments.tr: その支払いさえも滞るということは、家計が選択肢を使い果たしつつあることを示唆している。

segments.src: Other signs often cited alongside it include higher credit card balances, more use of "buy now, pay later" services and a slowdown in the growth of savings.
segments.tr: これと併せてよく挙げられるその他の兆候には、クレジットカード残高の増加、「今すぐ買っておき後で支払う（BNPL）」サービスの利用拡大、貯蓄増加の鈍化などがある。

segments.src: At the same time, many households remain in solid shape.
segments.tr: 同時に、多くの家計は依然として堅実な状態にある。

segments.src: Employment has been relatively strong and wages have grown in many sectors.
segments.tr: 雇用は比較的堅調であり、多くのセクターで賃金が上昇している。

segments.src: The stress is concentrated, not universal, which is why the strength of the labor market remains the key variable to watch.
segments.tr: ストレスは普遍的なものではなく集中しているため、労働市場の強さが注視すべき重要な変数であり続けている。

segments.src: ## What borrowers can do
segments.tr: ## 借り手にできること

segments.src: For people struggling with a car payment, acting early helps:
segments.tr: 車の支払いに苦しんでいる人にとって、早期に行動を起こすことが役立つ：

segments.src: - **Contact the lender before missing a payment.** Many offer deferments, extensions or modified terms.
segments.tr: - **支払いが遅れる前に貸し手に連絡する。** 多くの貸し手が猶予、延長、または条件変更に応じている。

segments.src: - **Consider refinancing** if your credit has improved or rates have fallen, but watch for fees and for terms that extend the loan too far.
segments.tr: - **借り換えを検討する**：信用力が向上した場合や金利が低下した場合には有効だが、手数料や、ローン期間が過度に延びる条件には注意する。

segments.src: - **Compare the full cost,** not only the monthly payment, when shopping for a vehicle. Total interest and loan length matter.
segments.tr: - 車を購入する際は、月々の支払額だけでなく、**総コストを比較する。** 総利息とローンの長さが重要である。

segments.src: - **Avoid rolling negative equity** from an old loan into a new one, which can deepen the debt.
segments.tr: - 古いローンのネガティブ・エクイティを新しいローンに繰り入れることを避ける。これは債務をさらに悪化させる可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Seek help from a nonprofit credit counseling agency** if several debts are becoming difficult to manage.
segments.tr: - 複数の債務の管理が難しくなっている場合は、**非営利の信用カウンセリング機関に相談する。**

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 次に注目すべき点

segments.src: Several developments will shape the outlook:
segments.tr: 今後の見通しを形作るいくつかの展開：

segments.src: - The direction of interest rates and whether auto loan costs ease.
segments.tr: - 金利の方向性と、自動車ローンのコストが緩和されるかどうか。

segments.src: - Used vehicle prices, which affect both borrower equity and lender recoveries.
segments.tr: - 中古車価格。これは借り手のエクイティと貸し手の回収額の両方に影響を与える。

segments.src: - The labor market, particularly layoffs among lower-income workers.
